title.en: Environmental Protection and Management (Prohibition on the Use of Open Fires) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Environmental Protection and Management (Prohibition on the Use of Open Fires) Order.

heading.en: Open fires prohibited in industrial or trade premises

text.en:
2. The use of open fires in any industrial or trade premises is prohibited, except where such open fires are used for —
(a)the purpose of fire fighting practices; or
(b)the disposal of tail gases from industrial plants.
[G.N. No. S 161/99]
